text.tspan: Lookup — resolve one name in a directory
(FUSE: readdir, one chunk at a time)
a negative answer the kernel caches
taken when the stream started — a background
revalidation between two chunks must not shift
offsets and thereby skip or duplicate entries
so a long-lived dirfd stops going blind)
fh 0, or past the stream cap: storing one
would leak, since no releasedir follows

g.text: Answer: entries until the buffer is full

text.tspan: apply what the background revalidator finished
pure: results are handed over, not fetched

g.text: has this directory ever been listed?

text.tspan: the only listing that makes the caller wait —
we have nothing to serve, so there is no choice
or a write of ours invalidated it)
the machine schedules a re-listing nobody waits for
waiting for joins this one; a second refresh is
dropped, so autosave cannot queue one per keystroke
a slow PROPFIND must never block

g.text: done — back to the calling script
